# Adding Logic {background-image="assets/symbol_logic.png" background-opacity="0.3" background-size="cover" background-color="#2d4059"}

Big-M controlled by boolean logic allows expressing nearly anything.

## At-most-one, exactly-one, implication

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="48%"}
**Counting**

$$
\sum_i b_i \le 1 \quad \text{at most one}
$$

::: {.fragment fragment-index=1}
$$
\sum_i b_i = 1 \quad \text{exactly one}
$$
:::

::: {.fragment fragment-index=2}
$$
\sum_i b_i \ge 1 \quad \text{at least one}
$$
:::
:::
::: {.column width="4%"}
:::
::: {.column width="48%"}
::: {.fragment fragment-index=3}
**Implication** $b_1 \Rightarrow b_2 \equiv b_1 \;\le\; b_2$.

::: {.compact-table}
| $b_1$ | $b_2$ | $b_1 \Rightarrow b_2$ | $b_1 \le b_2$ |
|---:|---:|:---:| :---:|
| $0$ | $0$ | ✓ | ✓ |
| $0$ | $1$ | ✓ | ✓ |
| $1$ | $0$ | ✗ | ✗ |
| $1$ | $1$ | ✓ | ✓ |
:::
:::

::: {.fragment fragment-index=4}
**Negation:** $\;\lnot b \;\equiv\; (1 - b).$
:::
:::
::::

::: {.fragment fragment-index=5}
::: {.platypus-tip}
With **at least one** and **negation**, we can already enforce any Boolean function on binaries.
However, if we want, e.g., to do $(b_1 \vee b_2) \Rightarrow c^\top x \le d$, we need the AND and OR bindings on the next two slides.
:::
:::

## AND-Binding

$$
z = b_1 \land b_2 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad z \le b_1, \;\; z \le b_2, \;\; z \ge b_1 + b_2 - 1.
$$

::: {.compact-table}
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>$b_1$</th><th>$b_2$</th><th>$z$</th><th>$b_1 \land b_2$</th><th>$z \le b_1$</th><th>$z \le b_2$</th><th>$z \ge b_1+b_2-1$</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="row-ok"><td>0</td><td>0</td><td>0</td><td>$= 0$</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td></tr>
<tr class="row-bad"><td>0</td><td>0</td><td>1</td><td>$\neq 0$</td><td>✗</td><td>✗</td><td>✓</td></tr>
<tr class="row-ok"><td>0</td><td>1</td><td>0</td><td>$= 0$</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td></tr>
<tr class="row-bad"><td>0</td><td>1</td><td>1</td><td>$\neq 0$</td><td>✗</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td></tr>
<tr class="row-ok"><td>1</td><td>0</td><td>0</td><td>$= 0$</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td></tr>
<tr class="row-bad"><td>1</td><td>0</td><td>1</td><td>$\neq 0$</td><td>✓</td><td>✗</td><td>✓</td></tr>
<tr class="row-bad"><td>1</td><td>1</td><td>0</td><td>$\neq 1$</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td><td>✗</td></tr>
<tr class="row-ok"><td>1</td><td>1</td><td>1</td><td>$= 1$</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
:::

::: {.fragment .platypus-tip}
**General $n$-ary form.** $z = \bigwedge_{i=1}^n b_i \;\Longleftrightarrow\; z \le b_i \;\;\forall i, \;\; z \ge \sum_{i=1}^n b_i - (n-1).$
:::

## OR-Binding

$$
z = b_1 \lor b_2 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad z \ge b_1, \;\; z \ge b_2, \;\; z \le b_1 + b_2.
$$

::: {.compact-table}
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>$b_1$</th><th>$b_2$</th><th>$z$</th><th>$b_1 \lor b_2$</th><th>$z \ge b_1$</th><th>$z \ge b_2$</th><th>$z \le b_1+b_2$</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="row-ok"><td>0</td><td>0</td><td>0</td><td>$= 0$</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td></tr>
<tr class="row-bad"><td>0</td><td>0</td><td>1</td><td>$\neq 0$</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td><td>✗</td></tr>
<tr class="row-bad"><td>0</td><td>1</td><td>0</td><td>$\neq 1$</td><td>✓</td><td>✗</td><td>✓</td></tr>
<tr class="row-ok"><td>0</td><td>1</td><td>1</td><td>$= 1$</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td></tr>
<tr class="row-bad"><td>1</td><td>0</td><td>0</td><td>$\neq 1$</td><td>✗</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td></tr>
<tr class="row-ok"><td>1</td><td>0</td><td>1</td><td>$= 1$</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td></tr>
<tr class="row-bad"><td>1</td><td>1</td><td>0</td><td>$\neq 1$</td><td>✗</td><td>✗</td><td>✓</td></tr>
<tr class="row-ok"><td>1</td><td>1</td><td>1</td><td>$= 1$</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td><td>✓</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
:::

::: {.fragment .platypus-tip}
**General $n$-ary form.** $z = \bigvee_{i=1}^n b_i \;\Longleftrightarrow\; z \ge b_i \;\;\forall i, \;\; z \le \sum_{i=1}^n b_i.$
:::
